# Feature construction

We currently use the raw pixel intensities as features. Describe any features
you construct here: what they measure, why you chose them, and how they are
computed.

Apply the same feature definition to training and test images, preserving image
order and using matching feature columns.

```{r feature-functions, code=readLines("R/features/features.R"), fold="Feature functions"}
source("R/features/features.R", local = TRUE)
```

```{r extract-features}
features_train <- features(x_train)
features_test <- features(x_test)
```
